purpose: Test-only inherited field graph preservation blocker. Current production engines and UI remain unchanged.

sourceEvidence.finding: UpdateReference skips Parent, Prev and First keys instead of remapping their referenced objects. Ordinary inherited widget field dictionaries are reached through Parent.

AttachWidget requires an unattached non-merged widget, rejects unknown authoring families, sets Parent, appends Kids, resets toggle AS, and calls BakeWidgetAppearance. The bounded native model-adoption counterexample retains field metadata but changes original AP pixels.
CreateField rejects a duplicate full field name. Main's page-copy export can retain distinct same-named fields from two sources.
The supported value model marks non-scalar/non-array values, including signature dictionaries, UNSUPPORTED. This evidence does not promise signature validity or new filling support.

Raw field capture is layer-based, carries original field/widget/page object numbers and requires an import transaction. It is not a cross-document field graph copier. This constraint is source evidence, not a tested production workaround.
Annotation export creates a flattened appearance document. It cannot preserve the inherited field graph.
GetLinkedAnnot requires a linked dictionary with Type Annot. Ordinary non-widget parent fields do not meet that requirement. The model counterexample checks this fixture-specific failure.

limits: Generated AP-backed text and radio widgets establish a concrete regression, not full PDF migration fidelity.

The baseline exercises current PDFOperationsService. Main rejects the original radio fixture because its positional /Opt entries cannot be preserved during per-page sibling pruning. Separate text-only positive controls assert inherited metadata, reciprocal parent/Kids membership with one retained widget per copied parent, and exact original AP pixels in all five scenarios.
Repeated import exercises source identity reuse; it is not a UI duplication end-to-end test.

All candidate outputs are saved and every native source/output handle is closed before bytes reach independent PDF.js reopening. Exact appearances are compared with the untouched source pages, independently of main's rejection, and field/group metadata are asserted separately.
Model adoption is restricted to the generated two-field full-import case. It is a bounded counterexample, not a production repair implementation.
Source-to-artifact mapping is the declared input evidence established in #316, not a reproducible final-link attestation.
Complete bundled distribution notices, security-fix review, other fidelity, worker lifetime/cache and measured performance remain separate production prerequisites.
parityCommand: PDFIUM_FIELDS_REQUIRE_PARITY=1 PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=4387 bun run test:e2e tests/e2e/pdfium-fields.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1
parityBehavior: Intentionally fails inherited metadata equality for full/plain on the pinned successor. Default tests assert the exact known deficit, exact original main rejection, successful text-only main controls, and untouched direct-save control; no tests are skipped or retried.
